uutiset.t: VIX Hits Highest Level Since 2025 Tariff Turmoil as Volatility Warning Flash
uutiset.s: The stock market’s main volatility gauge jumped to its highest level since April 2025 as the S&P 500 capped its worst week in seven months.

uutiset.t: Goldman Says Stock Selloff Has Legs as Panic Index Nears Maximum
uutiset.s: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s panic gauge climbed near its maximum level as US stocks tumbled Friday, signaling that another substantial wave of selling will follow over the coming week, according to the bank’s traders.

uutiset.t: Market Calm Hid Widespread Losses Under Surface, Schwab's Sonders Says
uutiset.s: Liz Ann Sonders, chief investment strategist at Charles Schwab, says broad market declines exposed weaknesses that were obscured by relative calm in major indexes. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Sonders also says she expects a 25 basis-point rate hike in December. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
uutiset.s: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector and create a company with a combined market value of about $265 billion.

uutiset.t: Hedge Funds Slash Bullish Bets on European Diesel To Wartime Low
uutiset.s: Hedge funds cut bullish gasoil bets to the lowest since before the US-Iran war began, according to ICE Futures Europe data, the latest sign that traders see a historic diesel crunch beginning to ease.

uutiset.t: Fear of Missing Out Driving Young Investors: Chaudhuri
uutiset.s: Buzzy stocks, leveraged ETFs, and a generation feeling left behind. Gargi Chaudhuri, chief investment and portfolio strategist at BlackRock, discusses ways investors can dabble in risky products while also leaning into time-proven strategies. She joins Tom Keene and Scarlet Fu on “Bloomberg Money.”

uutiset.t: Anthropic CEO Vacations at Italian Resort After Public Listing
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei is vacationing at a luxury resort in the south of Italy after completing a blockbuster initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: New Zealand Dollar Hits Lowest Since Global Financial Crisis
uutiset.s: The New Zealand dollar dropped to its weakest level since 2009, as investors’ risk sentiment soured globally over doubts about the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Bayer’s $7.25 Billion Roundup Settlement Approved by Judge
uutiset.s: A Missouri judge approved a Bayer AG proposal to contain its mounting legal costs by paying as much as $7.25 billion to resolve tens of thousands of US lawsuits by people who blame the company’s Roundup weedkiller for their cancers.

uutiset.t: Canadian Stocks Head for Correction as Metals, Tech Push Lower
uutiset.s: A key benchmark of Canadian equities is heading toward a technical correction on Friday as a selloff pushed metals, technology and energy stocks lower.

uutiset.t: SEC Aims to Directly Oversee Database Loathed by Wall Street
uutiset.s: The Securities and Exchange Commission moved Friday to bring a controversial trade reporting database criticized by much of Wall Street under its direct oversight.

uutiset.t: Trillions Podcast Live From Bloomberg ETFs in Depth: The Big Three
uutiset.s: Vanguard's Principal & Head of Bank & Institutional Financial Advisor Services Janel Jackson, Anna Paglia, Chief Business Officer at State Street Investment Management, and Elise Terry, Co-Head of Americas, Global Product Solutions & Head of Americas iShares at BlackRock, join Bloomberg's Eric Balch

uutiset.t: Anthropic’s IPO Drew More Retail Investor Demand Than SpaceX
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering drew roughly between $115 billion and $120 billion of demand for shares from retail investors, according to a person familiar with the matter, more than the amount sought by them in SpaceX’s debut.

uutiset.t: Wall Street Regulator Probes Nvidia Accounting, Reuters Says
uutiset.s: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating the accounting practices of Nvidia Corp., Reuters reported Friday, as the challenges facing the chipmaker continue to mount in the wake of Jensen Huang’s departure as chief executive officer.

uutiset.t: Bank Stocks Post Worst Week Since April 2025 as Rout Deepens
uutiset.s: Stocks of big US banks notched their worst weekly performance since last April’s tariff chaos, as concerns over cybersecurity and the unwinding of the artificial-intelligence trade engulfed the broader market.
